description: This file initializes and runs an FTP server within the Odoo framework, configuring connection parameters, IP detection, and logging.

classes.name: ftp_server
classes.description: A thread-based class that sets up and runs an FTP server, including IP detection and logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at specified levels using the netsvc Logger.

methods.name: detect_ip_addr
methods.description: Detects the server's IP address, attempting to handle UNIX and non-UNIX systems.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Configures and starts the FTP server, setting handlers, ports, and logging functions.
